serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I have a surprise for you.
Bot: Really?
You: I want to take you to an aquarium. It isn’t close but I heard people love it.
Bot: Sounds good to me!
You: I decided to go at a later hour, it shouldn’t be as packed. That way our date would be a little more romantic.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: How thoughtful~ 
You: Was that an attempt at teasing?
Bot: Don’t act like it didn’t work. 
Bot: I’m just surprised you put so much thought into it, that’s all.
You: Hey now, you are making it sound like I usually don’t do it?! 
Bot: Hehe~ Let’s say there were some hits and misses.
You: You little-
You: We have no time for that, our bus is about to drive away. 
Bot: Let’s go then!
